subject: chemistry
content: A 3.00 g sample containing Fe<sub>3</sub>O<sub>4</sub>, Fe<sub>2</sub>O<sub>3</sub> and an inert impure substance is treated with excess of KI solution in presence of dilute H<sub>2</sub>SO<sub>4</sub>. The entire iron is converted into Fe<sup>2+</sup>  along with the liberation of iodine. The resulting solution is diluted to 100 ml, A 20 ml of the diluted solution requires 11.0 ml of 0.5 M Na<sub>2</sub>S<sub>2</sub>O<sub>3</sub> solution to reduce the iodine present. A 50 ml of the diluted solution, after complete extraction of the iodine requires 12.80 ml of 0.25 M KMnO<sub>4</sub> solution in the dilute H<sub>2</sub>SO<sub>4</sub> medium for the oxidation of Fe<sup>2+</sup>. Calculate the percentages of Fe<sub>2</sub>O<sub>3</sub> and Fe<sub>3</sub>O<sub>4</sub> in the original sample.
